body.text:
models: {}
providers: {}
identity-providers:
  admin-tokens:
    module: admin-tokens
    token:
      env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN
auth:
  admin_auth:
  - admin-tokens
store:
  module: sqlite
  settings:
    db_path: busbar-governance.db

effects.stderr:
migrated 'testing/shadow-oracle/fixtures/migrate-operator-1.4-admin-token.yaml' to the 1.5.0 config shape.

CHANGES (4):
  - auth chain entry `admin-tokens: { … }` -> identity-providers.admin-tokens + a bare-name reference (1.5.3: define once, reference by name)
  - governance.admin_token -> auth.admin_auth: [ admin-tokens: { token: <secret-ref> } ]
  - governance.db_path -> store: { module: sqlite, settings: { db_path } } (1.4.x's only durable backend was SQLite)
  - governance.enabled removed (governance is presence-driven)

Review the output, then run `busbar --validate` on it before deploying.                  NOTE: 1.x virtual keys do not carry over - mint fresh signed keys (the 1.5.0                  security headline: keys now expire).
